issue.title: Bug: Tab-completion for command's OPTION doesn't work on TRIXIE

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

On TRIXIE (may be also on latest master)
Tab-completion is working for a Sonic-COMMANDs, but does NOT work for command’s OPTIONs

For example:
                sonic-installer li<TAB>     -- “li” is not completed to “list”
The completion has been working on Bookworm-202505 but not on TRIXIE.
----------
From other hand, the TRIXIE has an Improvement vs 202505 -- implicit “internal” completion
For example:
                Sonic-installer li<ENTER>       failed as incorrect command on Bookworm but Properly works on TRIXIE

### Steps to Reproduce

sonic-installer li<TAB>

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expected:
sonic-installer li<TAB>
sonic-installer list

Obtained
sonic-installer li

### Relevant log output

```shell

```

resolution.title: Update bash completions for sonic-utilities commands
resolution.description:
#### What I did

Update the bash completion files for all sonic-utilities commands to make them compatible with the current Click version.

Fixes sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#24594.

#### How I did it

Use [Click's documentation](https://click.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/shell-completion/) to generate the bash completion script for each command that is packaged from sonic-utilities and uses Click.

#### How to verify it

Tested in KVM in Trixie image.

```
admin@vlab-01:~$ sonic-package-manager
install     list        manifests   migrate     repository  reset       show        uninstall   update
```
